CurrentBody leads in skin science with 25% coverage, and Solawave in reviews with 10%. A recall headline about Therabody’s charger is in the news.  
Actions:  
- Pitch forbes.com, which covered competitors and did not cover FOREO.  
- Pitch harpersbazaar.com, which covered competitors and has covered FOREO before.
